parameters.name: MetaParentId
parameters.description:
The ID of the parent asset.

- Omit this parameter to retrieve databases.

- To retrieve tables in a specific database, set this parameter to the `dbId` of the database.

parameters.name: MetaType
parameters.description:
- Specify `META_DATABASE` to retrieve databases.

- Specify `META_TABLE` to retrieve tables in a specific database.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: TagName
parameters.description: The name of the tag. To retrieve database and table assets from a DataAgent Workspace, specify the tag name in the format `sys::DMS-DA::${DataAgentRegionId}::space:${DataAgentWorkspaceId}`.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

> You can find the tenant ID by hovering the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management Service (DMS) console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
